catalysts.headline: Corning (GLW) discloses $2bn at-the-market equity program with Goldman Sachs (Equity Distribution Agreement + prospectus supplement filed 2026-09-11); GLW fell ~12-14% Monday with direct optics-peer contagion -- Coherent -11%, Lumentum -9%, Fabrinet -6% (not held)

Was one of the four items in Monday's desk narrative but had NOT yet been logged as its own catalyst; added this run. Peer contagion (COHR/LITE) is a read-through, not a COHR/LITE-specific fundamental event.

catalysts.headline: GLJ Research (Gordon Johnson) initiates GE Vernova (GEV) at Sell, $470 price target -- 51% below the 09-11 close of $957.27 and described as the lowest target on Wall Street -- citing 2027-vintage turbine deliveries booked in 2024 pre-price-hikes (~3pp backlog margin vs 10-11pp on 2025-vintage shipping 2028); GEV fell ~9% Monday
catalysts.magnitude: Single boutique shop's outlier call -- GLJ's $470 PT is the Street's lowest, implying consensus sits well above it -- against no confirmed change in GE Vernova's own guidance. The backlog-margin mechanism (fixed-price turbine orders signed before 2024 price hikes, shipping in 2027) is real and checkable, but is one analyst's model, not a company disclosure or a peer-corroborated view yet; not name-checked in this note: VRT/BE, GEV's Power/Cooling cluster-mates (16.82% of equity combined), so treat as idiosyncratic to GEV, not proven cluster-wide.

catalysts.headline: ServiceNow (NOW) +6.4% Monday as investors rotated from AI infrastructure into enterprise software (Adobe +4%, Salesforce also up) while SMH fell -4.75%; sell-side reframing NOW's own AI products (crossed $1bn annual contract value in Q2 2026) as a monetization leg, not just a safe haven
